evidence.implementation: packages/mho-source implements immutable validated point requests, exact frame encoding, a typed one-write session and POSIX transport. The Click source endpoints delegate durable request/intent/result preservation and sealing. docs/research/rf-source-point-sender.md and packages/mho-source/README.md explain line handling, side effects and evidence limits. Implementation and this closure will be committed and pushed before the dependent physical trial.
evidence.controls: Known point and candidate vectors, invalid inputs, actual replying/silent PTYs, queued pre-input preservation, setup/write/read/close errors, short write, bounded receive overflow, intent durability failure and post-write evidence failure passed. PTYs cannot validate modem lines; physical execution requires clear/readback and cannot exclude driver open-time pulses. No physical serial endpoint opened during controls.
